ordered_predicates: candidate origin interval available and exactly [window.t0, window.t1]

participant_failure_mapping.meaning: At least one accepted_whole_window predicate is false after backend run_trial returns.

diagnostic_interpretation: A raw backend solver rejection or retry explains why a whole-window candidate may never be produced, but is not itself one of the wrapper acceptance predicates.
If result.completed=false, later bottom-exchange/time/candidate predicates may be consequences rather than independent primary failures.
If raw backend completes with a ready full-window candidate while participant status remains 6, investigate provenance/wrapper mismatch rather than hydrological solve failure.
Finite bottom exchange is necessary for participant admission but not sufficient for physical correctness; mass and transaction evidence remain separate.
